GNB.note: Participants are women and girls, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Fifty women and girls completed a seven-day trainer course on digital skills, digital security and financial education under the Justiça pa Tudu Djintis and Empoderamento da Mulher projects, run by UNDP and the Government of Guinea-Bissau with EU and UNDP funding.
